name: Cheesy Pesto Egg Smash
notes:
A creamy, cheesy egg smash with pesto, cottage cheese and Parmesan, toasted pine nuts for crunch and lemon to lift it.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 10 eggs
• 30g pine nuts
• 2 tbsp 5% fat Greek yoghurt
• 4 tbsp full-fat cottage cheese
• 2½ tbsp pesto
• 40g Parmesan
• ½ lemon
• Salt
• Black pepper
• 3 slices sourdough

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil. Lower in the eggs and cook for 8 mins.
2. Meanwhile, toast the pine nuts in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2–3 mins, tossing regularly, until golden. Tip out and set aside.
3. Cool the eggs in cold water, then peel. If you like, separate the yolks from the whites.
4. Add the eggs to a large bowl with the Greek yoghurt, cottage cheese and pesto. Grate in the Parmesan and squeeze in the lemon. Season, then smash everything together with a pizza cutter. Stir through most of the pine nuts, saving a few for the top. Taste and add more lemon, salt and pepper if needed.
5. Toast the bread, pile the smash on each slice and serve. Prepped ahead, the smash keeps in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 9g, fibre 2g, sugars 4g, sodium 970mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/high-protein-cheesy-pesto-egg-smash-on-toast
